title: Dimension function by immediate geometric specializations
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A function $\delta:|X|\to\mathbf Z$ is a dimension function if for every geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_x\to X$ [def-weil-geometric-point] and every geometric point $a:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_y\to X_{(\bar x)}$ of its strict localization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], whenever the closure of the image of $a$ has Krull dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], one has $\delta(\rho_{\bar x}(a))=\delta(x)+1$. Here $x$ is the underlying point of $\bar x$ and $\rho_{\bar x}:X_{(\bar x)}\to X$ is the canonical structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map].
